correctness.rationale: Substituting the constant-coefficient path Laplacian into equations (3.6), (3.13) and (3.39) of arXiv:2611.02282 produces the exact Heun polynomial in the symmetric filter. Three orthogonal projectors reduce cone preservation to one scalar inequality. The two explicit integer polynomials M and P each have one descending-coefficient sign change; their rational signs at 0,1 and 3,4, respectively, prove unique positive roots and the unique global optimal splitting ratio, without relying on finite sampling. verify.py symbolically checks polynomial identities and the separate direct rational resolvent witness T13=-37010590/4202539929. The result is limited to completed steps in the stated three-site/energy-stable regime.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural benchmark for positivity versus unconditional quadratic-energy stability of a new high-order filtered diffusion method. It identifies a nonempty splitting-ratio gap and computes the unique sharp all-timestep coefficient boundary on the smallest possible connected graph. A rational negative transition at an energy-stable parameter value makes the distinction operational; the exact extra splitting requirement removes the defect on that model. No unsupported universal extension or runtime-performance claim is made.
